extra.message: The email values read from the uploaded partner CSV are interpolated directly into a native SQL statement (email in (" + inList + ")) and executed with entityManager.createNativeQuery(). An attacker controlling the uploaded reference list can inject arbitrary SQL, e.g. an email of ') or 1=1 -- to dump or modify arbitrary rows of the contacts table.

cwe: CWE-89: SQL Injection

extra.message: The request body fields paper and sourceUrl from POST /api/export/{report}/pdf are concatenated into the single command string executed by ProcessBuilder("cmd", "/c", ...). Because the whole line is passed to cmd.exe, shell metacharacters supplied by the caller (for example & calc.exe or | powershell) execute arbitrary operating-system commands on the server.

cwe: CWE-78: OS Command Injection

extra.message: RuleExpressionService.evaluate parses and evaluates an attacker-supplied string with a SpEL SpelExpressionParser backed by a StandardEvaluationContext. It is reachable from POST /api/export/score/preview with the formula request parameter. StandardEvaluationContext permits arbitrary type references and method invocation (for example T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec(...)), giving remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code

extra.message: ScoringFormulaService.evaluate compiles and executes a caller-supplied MVEL expression (MVEL.executeExpression(MVEL.compileExpression(formula), variables)) via POST /api/export/score/formula. MVEL allows Java method/constructor invocation, so a crafted formula achieves remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code

extra.message: findStaff builds an LDAP search filter by string concatenation with the caller-controlled account parameter (GET /api/staff/directory): (&(objectClass=person)(sAMAccountName=" + account + ")). A value such as *)(|(objectClass=*) injects arbitrary LDAP filter logic and can enumerate or bypass directory entries.

cwe: CWE-90: LDAP Injection

extra.message: resolveStaffMail concatenates the caller-controlled mailbox parameter into an LDAP filter: (&(objectClass=person)(mail=" + mailbox + ")). POST /api/staff/directory/mail therefore allows LDAP filter injection and directory data exfiltration.

cwe: CWE-90: LDAP Injection

extra.message: plansFeed builds an XPath expression by concatenating the X-Crmops-Plan request header into //plan[code='...'] and evaluates it with XPathFactory. Unescaped single quotes let a caller alter the predicate and read arbitrary nodes of the parsed document.

cwe: CWE-643: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions

extra.message: findPlan concatenates the code request parameter into an XPath expression and evaluates it with dom4j catalog.selectNodes("//plan[code='" + code + "']"). A crafted code terminates the literal and injects arbitrary XPath, allowing data disclosure from the catalog document.

cwe: CWE-643: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions

extra.message: queueView Base64-decodes the caller-supplied X-CrmOps-Queue header and passes it to new ObjectInputStream(...).readObject(). Deserializing untrusted bytes with no class allow-list enables gadget-chain attacks and remote code execution for any holder of a valid API key.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: savedView deserializes the caller-supplied view request parameter with a default new XStream().fromXML(view). Default XStream permits arbitrary types and is a known remote-code-execution gadget, exploitable by any caller holding a valid API key.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: importContactsXml parses the uploaded partner XML with a default SAXParserFactory that has no secure-processing feature flags (disallow-doctype-decl, external-general-entities, ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD). A crafted document with an external entity can read local files or perform SSRF during parsing.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: The public /api/share/documents/{id} endpoint decodes the grant with JWT.decode(grant) instead of JWT.require(...).verify(...). The HMAC signature is never validated, so the org claim is fully attacker-controlled. A forged grant lets an unauthenticated caller download documents from any organization by setting org to the target org and iterating document ids.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: The report path variable is concatenated into outDir.resolve(report + ".pdf") without validation. A value containing ../ sequences escapes the temporary directory, and the external renderer is directed to write the resulting .pdf to an attacker-chosen filesystem path (arbitrary file write outside the intended directory).

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

extra.message: importFromLink accepts a caller-supplied assetUrl and issues a server-side GET with RestClient.create().get().uri(URI.create(assetUrl)). Validation only checks the http/https prefix, so an attacker with document.upload permission can force requests to internal services and cloud metadata endpoints (for example http://169.254.169.254/).

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery

extra.message: renderedSummary injects the escalation description straight into the DOM via summary.getElement().setProperty("innerHTML", view.description()). The description is user-controlled when an escalation is created or replied to, so a stored <script> or event-handler payload executes for any staff or customer who opens the escalation.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: ready() writes the report path variable and the raw User-Agent request header into a text/html response with no encoding. GET /api/export/{report}/ready reflects attacker-controlled markup, yielding reflected XSS (and header-derived injection) in a victim's browser.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: The CORS configuration allows every origin (setAllowedOriginPatterns(List.of("*"))) while also enabling credentials. Any website can therefore make credentialed cross-origin requests to /api/export/** and /api/reference/** using a logged-in user's session cookie, enabling data theft and CSRF-style abuse of the export endpoints.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

extra.message: Spring Security CSRF protection is disabled for /api/v1/**, /api/reference/** and /api/export/**. Combined with the wildcard credentialed CORS policy, a malicious page can drive state-changing POST endpoints such as /api/export/score/formula and /api/export/score/preview in a victim's authenticated session.

cwe: CWE-352: Cross-Site Request Forgery

extra.message: After login the app reads request.getHeader("Referer") and passes it to UI.getCurrent().getPage().setLocation(returnTarget) with no same-origin validation. An attacker who lures a user to the login page with a crafted Referer can redirect the freshly authenticated user to an arbitrary external site (open redirect / credential-phishing vector).

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: current() trusts the org id encoded in the crm_ws cookie and returns that organization's data without verifying the authenticated user is a member of it. A customer contact can edit the Base64 cookie to any orgId (for example BASE64(orgId:userId)) and enumerate other organizations' names and identifiers.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: integrationsReport writes the webhook signing secret (config.getSecret()) into the integrations.csv export, despite the documented rule that webhook secrets are masked in every UI and never returned. cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: Desk operator passphrases are stored and compared using unsalted MD5 (md5(passphrase)) rather than an adaptive password hash. MD5 is fast and collision-prone, so stored verifiers can be brute-forced or looked up in precomputed tables.

cwe: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort

extra.message: The portal device-confirmation code is generated with ThreadLocalRandom (non-cryptographic) instead of SecureRandom. The generated value guards device trust in PortalAccessController.confirm, so its predictability weakens the confirmation control.

cwe: CWE-330: Use of Insufficiently Random Values

extra.message: SharedLinkCodec encrypts and decrypts shared report/rebate links with a hardcoded AES key and a static, hardcoded IV ("Crm0psSharedL1nk"/"Crm0psSharingIv0") using AES/CBC. Anyone with source access can decrypt or forge link payloads, and the reused IV leaks plaintext equality; the key should come from a secret store and the IV should be random per message.

cwe: CWE-321: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key

extra.message: The application disables X-Frame-Options for the whole app (headers.frameOptions(frame -> frame.disable())), removing clickjacking protection. Any external site can embed the CRM in an iframe and overlay UI to trick authenticated users into performing actions.
